items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And then we had Tommy Ladnere... Schaffner played with us... we got Tommy Ladnere.

ctx.x: Schaffner was with Wickliffe? I was trying to remember.

Yeah, Schaffner, I remember, yeah, Schaffner played with us. And then we had Tommy Ladnere, and then another time. Schaffner played with us off and on many years. And one time his lip went bad, and I think we sent in your own, he didn't got Tommy Ladnere. And Red Allen. Oh, another time we had Red Allen playing with us. And little Ted McMurray. Remember him, little Ted McMurray? No. He was one of the nice little jazz trumpeters of that 1920s. And Did Sudler play with Wickliffe for a time? No, Sudler, Joe Sudler…

at Harman's, Elvis Band at Harman's Dreamland. Well, I somehow get Sudler and another good trumpet player, a man from Louisville in the entertainers at some period. And I don't know who, what band it would be with. Bobby somebody, two trumpet players, and they work well as a team, Sudler and... Oh, let's see. Several people... After we left... They never recorded, Sudler never played a hot chorus on record, so we don't know. No,
